appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line plot displays the data trend across the years 1880 to 1891.
The line begins at a vertical position corresponding to approximately 1,000 on the y-axis in 1880.
From 1880 to 1890, the line exhibits a general upward trajectory, reaching its highest point at the 1890 mark.
The line peaks at a vertical position slightly above the 3,000 grid line in 1890.
The line descends from the 1890 peak to a lower position in 1891, ending near the 2,900 level.
The endpoint of the line in 1891 is significantly higher on the page than the starting point in 1880.

printed_facts.fact: The title reads 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
The y-axis is labeled 'Number of Tourists' with tick marks at intervals of 500, ranging from 0 to 3,000.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' with tick marks for each year from 1880 to 1891.

uncertain: There is a direct conflict between the chart's title ('Decreasing Number...') and the visual data shown in the line plot (which shows an increase from ~1,000 to ~2,900).
The specific numerical value for the 1891 data point is not explicitly labeled, though it appears to be just below 3,000.
